FINDING_legacy_signup_gift_memo.scope_from_source: shenanigans/main.mo mintInternal sends memo = Text.encodeUtf8(eventId) unchanged. Event ids: game deposits "game-<id>" / "game-sol-<id>" (short, within 32); signup gifts "signup-<principal>" / "signup-sol-<principal>" (70 / 74 bytes); backer mints "backer-<principal>-<float>" / "backer-sol-…" (> 75 bytes); cascade kickups "kickup-A<rank>-<eventId>" inherit the event id's length. So on a 32-byte-memo ledger the legacy signup-gift AND legacy backer mints (and their cascade legs) cannot commit; game deposit mints can.
